prompt:

Create ONE finished square Swedish vocabulary artwork for an adult mobile flashcard app. Use the Finnish iOS card style: vivid tactile realistic editorial illustration, memorable scale and clear action, warm light, cream header with fine gold edging, bold navy typography, integrated cream/gold memory-link caption, pale blue bottom example strip. Header text verbatim: "arbete". Smaller English meaning verbatim: "labor".
Scene: A team of adults carefully building a stone wall together, visibly exerting physical effort while using safe lifting techniques.
Memory-link caption verbatim: "arbete = work or labor; picture physical effort.".
Swedish example in bottom strip verbatim: "Det krävdes mycket hårt arbete.".
Teach only the sense shown by this sentence. Print only the supplied heading, English meaning, memory caption and Swedish example. If the caption contains a sound/spelling association, mark it with the small exact label "Memory trick".
styleReference: Established card style described in the prompt; no image supplied.
